clocks.presentation: trial-relative schedule; host onset retained in trial LOG

fields.group_id: monotonic source render-group identity; video slots map to original group state and evaluation time
fields.capture: per-group admission, same-slot omission, and explicit real/duplicate encoded-slot mapping

clocks.video: first usable evaluation per nominal slot; duplicate mappings preserve source group/time

fields.review_composite: one tiled lossy review stream; no original-pixel guarantee
fields.frame_correspondence: video slot n maps to a real source group or an explicitly labeled duplicate
fields.fragmentation: fragmented MP4; no hybrid conversion or remux
